# cookie-compliance-agent-manual

> Skills and cookbooks that teach a coding agent to install the Cookie Compliance consent banner (by Hu-manity.co) so it blocks trackers before consent, not just shows a notice afterward.

Cookie Compliance is a consent management platform (CMP) for GDPR, CCPA and similar laws, published by Hu-manity.co (https://hu-manity.co/llms.txt). The product itself — capabilities, pricing, the MCP server — is documented at https://cookie-compliance.co/llms.txt; this repo is the agent-facing companion that shows how to actually install and verify the banner.

No account yet? Sign up at https://app.hu-manity.co/#/register?enable-free=true&discount=JOIN-40D&utm_source=agent-manual&utm_medium=docs&utm_content=llms-txt (free plan, no card); with the MCP server connected, call `help.startSignup` instead.

First-payment discount: code `JOIN-40D` takes 40% off the first payment of a new paid subscription (not trial plans; one discount per subscription; the checkout shows the discounted amount). The signup links in this manual already carry it, so checkout pre-fills it if the person subscribes within 7 days in the same browser.

## Start here

- [start](start.md): the one page to follow to install the banner start to finish. Autopilot by default; asks the person only to sign in or register, make the legal region choice, and approve anything that costs money.
- [connect](connect.md): connect an AI app (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Codex) to Cookie Compliance. Which address to use, the steps per app, the API-token fallback, and how to check it worked.
- [prompts](prompts.md): copy-paste prompts for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Codex and agents without MCP.

## Skills

- [install-banner](skills/install-banner/SKILL.md): get the live snippet for an AppID and place it correctly. Shipped.
- [verify-install](skills/verify-install/SKILL.md): prove the banner blocks trackers before consent, on any Cookie Compliance install. Shipped.
- [match-site-design](skills/match-site-design/SKILL.md): derive a banner design from the site's own colours and check WCAG AA contrast. Shipped.
- [configure-regions](skills/configure-regions/SKILL.md): set which regulations apply and how visitors are treated by region (GDPR, CCPA, and others). Shipped.

## Cookbooks

- [plain-html](cookbooks/plain-html.md): paste the snippet into a static site's `<head>`.
- [wordpress](cookbooks/wordpress.md): install via the Cookie Compliance for WordPress plugin, not a pasted snippet.
- [nextjs](cookbooks/nextjs.md): place the snippet correctly in a Next.js layout.
- [gtm](cookbooks/gtm.md): put the snippet above the Google Tag Manager container in `<head>`, never inside GTM.
- [nuxt](cookbooks/nuxt.md): place the snippet in `nuxt.config.ts`, not a composable or client plugin — and never mark it `async`.
- [astro](cookbooks/astro.md): place the snippet in the shared layout with `is:inline` on every tag, or Astro silently defers it as a module.
- [shopify](cookbooks/shopify.md): place the snippet first in `layout/theme.liquid`'s `<head>` — not checkout Additional scripts or a Customer Events pixel.

## Example projects

Runnable apps in the repository under `examples/`. Each places the snippet first in the shared document. They illustrate placement; the procedure is still the skills and cookbooks. Not published as site pages.

- [examples](examples/README.md): index of stacks, the file that owns `<head>`, and how to run each app.
- Stacks and the file that owns `<head>`: ASP.NET Razor Pages (`Pages/Shared/_Layout.cshtml`), Blazor (`Components/App.razor`), Angular (`src/index.html`), React Vite (`index.html`), Vue Vite (`index.html`), SvelteKit (`src/app.html`), Laravel (`resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php`), Django (`templates/base.html`), Rails (`app/views/layouts/application.html.erb`), Next.js (`app/layout.tsx`), Nuxt (`nuxt.config.ts`), Astro (`src/layouts/Layout.astro`), Express (`templates/layout.html`), Spring Boot (`src/main/resources/templates/layout.html`), Go (`templates/layout.html`), Flask (`templates/base.html`), FastAPI (`templates/base.html`), Fastify (`templates/layout.html`), NestJS (`templates/layout.html`), Symfony (`templates/base.html.twig`), Eleventy (`src/_includes/base.njk`), plain HTML (`index.html`, `about/index.html`, `product/index.html`), Google Tag Manager (`index.html`, `about/index.html`, `product/index.html`), Hono (`templates/layout.html`), React Router (`app/root.tsx`), Solid (`index.html`), Qwik (`index.html`), Jekyll (`_layouts/default.html`), Hugo (`layouts/baseof.html`).

## Design gallery

- [gallery](gallery/README.md): example banner designs, each with a screenshot and the exact design JSON to apply.
- [gallery/v2](gallery/v2/README.md): example designs for the v2 banner (standard and compact styles), with the design and config JSON to apply and how to switch an app to v2.
